note: Main application sidebar -- renders: user status, navigation icon buttons (Home, Messages, etc.), and fixed section labels
Rooms list sidebar -- renders: fixed section headers (e.g. 'Channels', 'Teams') and navigation controls; channel names are user-generated but the container is the navigation widget
Sidebar footer -- renders: platform logo and version information
Sidebar user profile block -- renders: current user's display name and status, which are self-authored by the logged-in user
Main content page heading -- renders: fixed page title (e.g. 'Channels')
Tab navigation -- renders: fixed tab labels (e.g. 'Channels', 'Teams', 'Direct')

ancestor_path.class: rcx-box rcx-box--full rcx-label  rcx-box rcx-box--full rcx-box--animated rcx-input-box__wrapper

note: Search input container -- renders: search box control; the query text is user input but the widget is trusted chrome
Table header row -- renders: fixed column headers (e.g. 'Name', 'Members', 'Last Activity')
Pagination controls -- renders: page numbers and navigation buttons
